scope: Read-only review of the frozen sysfs-size observer correction
findings: Only the frozen apparmorEnabled descriptor gains sizeHintOnly. No caller-supplied path or unbounded metadata flag is accepted.
The held descriptor remains opened read-only with O_NOFOLLOW. Non-regular targets still fail before reading.

The AppArmor field allocates 17 bytes for its 16-byte limit. Each read requests only the remaining buffer, partial reads advance within that buffer, and 17 observed bytes return SIZE_LIMIT without a truncated value.

Both fstat observations still bind dev, ino, size, mode, mtimeNs and ctimeNs. A changed held descriptor returns FILE_CHANGED. Finally closes the descriptor, and a close error prevents an observed result.
All other host fields retain the metadata-size rejection. The fixed bubblewrap binary still rejects a claimed size above 8 MiB before any read.
Value parsing still accepts only one Y, N, 0 or 1 after trimming, under the existing ASCII check and byte limit.
No host control, filesystem permission, namespace policy, worker execution or readiness verdict is changed. This patch changes only read-only host observation.
The actual run 91 SIZE_LIMIT observation does not prove a page-sized st_size cause because actual field bytes were not retained. Local ENOENT provides no native AppArmor value or isolation evidence.
